title: bookmarks
summary: Lists or finds the dl:bk comment-anchor bookmarks in a unit or a folder
intro: Read this when you marked code with // dl:bk3 or // dl:bk:A7K3QX comments and want them listed, or one found by its code: bookmarks prints file:line for each anchor and never writes.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint bookmarks --in <file.pas|dir> [--name <code>] [--json] (list / find the // dl:bk<N> and // dl:bk:<CODE> comment anchors; read-only; exit 3 = none)
